summary: Moleculin Biotech filed an 8-K reporting stockholder-approved charter amendment and board-set 1-for-20 reverse stock split, effective 12:01 a.m. ET on October 20, 2026; shares trade post-split on Nasdaq under MBRX with new CUSIP 60855D507. Outstanding shares fall from roughly 20.91 million to about 1.05 million, par value unchanged at $0.001, authorized shares held at 500 million. Options, RSUs and warrants adjust proportionally. This is a routine capital-structure mechanic to cure listing-price compliance, not a special situation. Watch post-split liquidity, any further Nasdaq deficiency notice, and financing overhang.
